title: Perceptual meta-uncertainty reveals enhanced calibration of sensory confidence in autism.
summary: Atypical metacognition has been suggested to underlie autistic phenotypes, given its role in social cognition and behavioral flexibility. However, no study has quantitatively assessed metacognitive abilities in autism. Here, we measured meta-uncertainty-the noise corrupting estimates of one's own decision uncertainty-in autism. In three experiments, autistic and non-autistic participants (N = 145) performed orientation categorization tasks while simultaneously reporting their choice confidence. By independently manipulating each Bayesian component-sensory uncertainty, prior, and reward-and fitting a recently established process model, we assessed metacognitive abilities and their contingency on the Bayesian components while controlling for first-order decisions. Unlike non-autistic participants, autistic participants' meta-uncertainty depended on which decision component was manipulated and was lower than that of non-autistic participants, specifically when decisions were adjusted for sensory uncertainty. These findings reveal that metacognition in autism is not generally reduced but rather enhanced for inferences that rely primarily on sensory information.

标题：感知元不确定性揭示自闭症中感觉置信度的增强校准
摘要：非典型元认知因在社会认知和行为灵活性中的作用，被认为可能是自闭症表型的基础。然而，尚无研究对自闭症中的元认知能力进行定量评估。本研究测量了自闭症中的元不确定性——即个体对自身决策不确定性估计中的噪声。在三项实验中，自闭症与非自闭症参与者（N = 145）执行朝向分类任务，同时报告其选择置信度。通过独立操控每个贝叶斯成分（感觉不确定性、先验和奖赏），并拟合最近建立的过程模型，我们在控制一阶决策的同时评估了元认知能力及其对各贝叶斯成分的依存性。与非自闭症参与者不同，自闭症参与者的元不确定性依赖于被操控的决策成分，且当决策依据感觉不确定性进行调整时，其元不确定性显著低于非自闭症参与者。这些发现表明，自闭症中的元认知并非普遍降低，而是在主要依赖感觉信息的推理中表现出增强的校准能力。
关键词：元认知；元不确定性；自闭症；感觉置信度；贝叶斯决策

title: Associative learning of social interaction alters attention to human faces.
summary: Beyond current goals and physical salience, selection history reflects how past experience automatically biases visual attention. While existing frameworks characterize how we learn to prioritize non-social regularities such as reward and spatial probability, whether selection history can incorporate abstract social structures governing interactions between others remains unknown. Across four experiments (N = 144), we examined whether observed social configurations produce lasting attentional biases toward individual agents. Participants first viewed pairs of human faces arranged in interacting (face-to-face) or non-interacting (back-to-back) configurations. In a subsequent cueing task, faces previously shown interacting captured attention more strongly than those shown non-interacting. This effect was abolished by face inversion and absent for non-social directional stimuli (arrows, animal faces), ruling out contributions from low-level visual features or general directional cueing. Together, these findings indicate that social interaction history induces lasting changes in the priority map, endowing faces with learned attributes that guide selection in social environments.

标题：社会互动的联想学习改变了对人脸的注意
摘要：超越当前目标和物理显著性，选择历史反映了过往经验如何自动偏向视觉注意。尽管现有框架描述了人们如何学会优先处理非社会性规律（如奖赏和空间概率），但选择历史能否纳入支配他人之间互动的抽象社会结构仍属未知。通过四项实验（N = 144），我们考察了观察到的社会配置是否会对个体行动者产生持久的注意偏向。参与者首先观看以互动（面对面）或非互动（背对背）配置排列的人脸对。在随后的线索任务中，先前以互动方式呈现的面孔比以非互动方式呈现的面孔更能吸引注意。这一效应在面孔倒置时被消除，且对非社会性方向刺激（箭头、动物面孔）不出现，排除了低水平视觉特征或一般方向线索的贡献。综合而言，这些发现表明社会互动历史会在优先图中诱发持久变化，赋予面孔习得的属性，从而引导社会环境中的选择。
关键词：选择历史；社会互动；注意偏向；联想学习；面孔加工

title: Dissecting disgust and fear in chimpanzees: From facilitation to disruption of cognitive processes.
summary: Disgust and fear are emotions that evolved to address different types of threats: pathogens and predators, respectively. Yet the cognitive mechanisms underlying disgust remain poorly understood, particularly in non-human animals. We investigated how pathogen- and predator-related stimuli influence cognition in captive chimpanzees (Pan troglodytes), using touchscreen and eye-tracking tasks. In three experiments, subjects performed a number ordering task while exposed to images (e.g., carcasses, rotten food, invertebrates, snakes) or odors (e.g., of organic decomposition, emesis). Pathogen-related stimuli, particularly those linked to organic decomposition and fermentation, modulated performance in distinct temporal patterns, reducing accuracy and later disrupting efficiency upon re-exposure. In contrast, predator images enhanced performance by reducing response latencies. A fourth eye-tracking experiment further showed that both carcass and snake images captured and held attention. Overall, our results suggest distinct cognitive signatures for pathogen-versus predator-related threats in chimpanzees, offering insight into the evolution of defensive emotions.

标题：解析黑猩猩的厌恶与恐惧：从认知过程的促进到干扰
摘要：厌恶和恐惧是演化出来分别应对不同类型威胁（病原体和捕食者）的情绪。然而，厌恶背后的认知机制仍然知之甚少，尤其是在非人类动物中。我们利用触屏和眼动追踪任务，研究了病原体相关和捕食者相关刺激如何影响圈养黑猩猩（Pan troglodytes）的认知。在三个实验中，受试者在接触图像（如尸体、腐烂食物、无脊椎动物、蛇）或气味（如有机分解物、呕吐物）的同时执行数字排序任务。病原体相关刺激，尤其是与有机分解和发酵相关的刺激，以不同的时间模式调节行为表现：降低准确性，并在再次暴露时干扰效率。相比之下，捕食者图像通过减少反应潜伏期提升了表现。第四个眼动实验进一步表明，尸体和蛇的图像均能捕获并维持注意力。总体而言，我们的结果表明黑猩猩对病原体相关与捕食者相关威胁具有不同的认知特征，为防御性情绪的演化提供了见解。
关键词：厌恶；恐惧；黑猩猩；情绪认知；病原体规避

title: Investigating the relationship between affective valence and reinforcement learning.
summary: Affective valence and reinforcement learning (RL) are increasingly recognized to be closely connected, yet the exact nature of their relationship remains unclear. Here, we investigated how RL-related computations contribute to affective valence, and how affective valence, in turn, contributes to RL. Applying an original computational method, we found that affective experience during RL tasks was best explained by a combination of three prominent theoretical perspectives: valence is determined by reward, prediction errors, and counterfactual comparisons. Further, we found that actions were reinforced by affective responses in addition to external rewards: participants preferred choice options that led to more positive affect, in addition to preferring options that led to greater reward. Altogether, our results illuminate the role of RL computations in affective experience and of affect in RL, providing mechanistic insight into affect, learning, and choice. Moreover, our studies validate a powerful new computational framework for future research on these topics.

标题：探究情感效价与强化学习之间的关系
摘要：情感效价与强化学习（RL）日益被认为是紧密相关的，但二者之间关系的具体性质仍不明确。本研究探讨了RL相关计算如何贡献于情感效价，以及情感效价又如何反过来促进RL。通过应用一种原创的计算方法，我们发现RL任务中的情感体验最好由三种重要理论视角的组合来解释：效价由奖赏、预测误差和反事实比较共同决定。此外，我们发现行为反应不仅受到外部奖赏的强化，还受到情感反应的强化：参与者更偏好那些能引发更积极情感的选择项，同时也在偏好能带来更大奖赏的选项。总体而言，我们的结果阐明了RL计算在情感体验中的作用以及情感在RL中的作用，为情感、学习和选择提供了机制性见解。此外，我们的研究验证了一个强大的新计算框架，可用于未来在这些主题上的研究。
关键词：情感效价；强化学习；预测误差；反事实比较；情感体验

title: Age and loneliness relate to reduced trust learning and alterations in amygdala function.
summary: Functional relationships are essential for healthy aging and they rely on social cognition skills such as establishing and monitoring whom to trust. However, aging and loneliness can negatively affect social brain function, potentially leading to a vicious cycle. Using functional MRI and computational modeling, we investigated trust learning in a sample of neurotypical older (64-84 years, n = 29 f/23 m) compared to younger adults (20-33 years, n = 31 f/31 m). Older participants displayed lower initial trust and less trust learning when repeatedly interacting with a trustworthy and an untrustworthy trustee. Their basolateral and central amygdala activation was lower during trust decisions, and this was associated with less optimal trust behavior. Computational modeling also revealed that a crucial learning parameter, precision of the trust prediction error, and activation in the dopaminergic midbrain were decoupled from basolateral amygdala activation, and this effect was pronounced in lonely older adults. These findings indicate that differences in amygdala and dopamine function at older ages together with higher loneliness could impair trust learning, leading to poorer social cognition and putting individuals' sociality and well-being at risk.

标题：年龄与孤独感与信任学习减弱及杏仁核功能变化的关系
摘要：功能性的社会关系对健康老龄化至关重要，其依赖于建立和监测信任对象等社会认知能力。然而，衰老和孤独感可能对社会脑功能产生负面影响，进而可能导致恶性循环。本研究采用功能性磁共振成像和计算建模，在一组神经典型老年人（64-84岁，n = 29名女性/23名男性）与年轻人（20-33岁，n = 31名女性/31名男性）中考察了信任学习。老年参与者在与可信赖和不可信赖的受托人反复互动时，表现出较低的初始信任和较少的信任学习。他们在信任决策过程中，基底外侧和中央杏仁核的激活水平较低，这与较不优化的信任行为相关。计算建模还揭示，一个关键的学习参数——信任预测误差的精确性——以及多巴胺能中脑的激活与基底外侧杏仁核激活之间的耦合发生解离，且这一效应在孤独感较高的老年人中尤为显著。这些发现表明，老年期的杏仁核和多巴胺功能差异，加之较高的孤独感，可能损害信任学习，导致社会认知能力下降，并将个体的社交性和幸福感置于风险之中。
关键词：信任学习；杏仁核；孤独感；衰老；社会认知

title: Temporal dynamics of frontoparietal processing during personal space intrusion.
summary: Understanding the neural basis of personal space (PS) is crucial for elucidating the mechanisms of social behavior. We investigated EEG responses in healthy adults viewing approaching faces designed to simulate intrusions into PS. Approaching faces elicited stronger right N170 modulation than static faces, with weaker effects for non-face objects. Time-frequency analyses revealed early alpha-power decreases over the frontal region of interest (ROI), followed by later alpha-power decreases and gamma-power increases over the parietal ROI, selectively for approaching faces. Motion information was decoded earlier in the parietal ROI than in the frontal ROI, with the frontal ROI showing face-specific sensitivity. We further demonstrated sustained parietal-to-frontal low-gamma feedforward signaling during face approach, with late frontal-to-parietal alpha-band feedback. Crucially, feedforward signaling predicted individual PS size. Together, these findings suggest that coordinated frontoparietal interactions may facilitate rapid detection and continuous monitoring of PS intrusions, providing a mechanistic framework for adaptive social defense.

标题：个人空间入侵过程中额顶叶处理的时间动态
摘要：理解个人空间（PS）的神经基础对于阐明社会行为的机制至关重要。我们研究了健康成年人在观看接近面孔（模拟对PS的入侵）时的脑电图反应。接近面孔比静态面孔引发了更强的右侧N170调制，而非面孔物体的效应较弱。时频分析显示，额叶感兴趣区（ROI）早期出现α功率下降，随后顶叶ROI出现晚期α功率下降和γ功率增加，这些效应仅对接近面孔显著。运动信息在顶叶ROI中被解码的时间早于额叶ROI，且额叶ROI表现出面孔特异性敏感性。我们还证明，在面孔接近过程中存在持续的顶叶至额叶低频γ前馈信号，以及晚期额叶至顶叶α波段反馈。至关重要的是，前馈信号预测了个体的PS大小。综合来看，这些发现表明，协调的额顶叶相互作用可能促进对PS入侵的快速检测和持续监测，为适应性社会防御提供了机制框架。
关键词：个人空间；额顶叶网络；脑电图；前馈与反馈；面孔接近

title: MindTS-Net: A multimodal mindfulness-based intervention framework for children with Tourette syndrome.
summary: Tourette syndrome affects children's daily functioning and creates a need for supervised support that responds to tic behaviors, emotional states, and interaction contexts. We developed MindTS-MMD, a Chinese multimodal dataset capturing emotion, tic-related behaviors, interaction context, and Valence-Arousal ratings, and MindTS-Net, a supervised digital adjunct linking multimodal emotion perception, mindfulness strategy planning, child-appropriate guidance generation, and dialogue-state tracking. Evaluation included dataset benchmarking, a 14-day primary clinical study with 60 children, and an independent external validation cohort of 57 children from a second clinical center. MindTS-Net improved emotion perception, strategy selection, and guidance quality compared with baseline approaches. In the primary study, children receiving MindTS-Net showed favorable Valence-Arousal changes and reduced tic burden. External validation showed consistent directions across perception, strategy, guidance, and intervention outcomes. These findings suggest that supervised multimodal digital support can complement pediatric tic management and provide a foundation for future multi-center research.

标题：MindTS-Net：针对图雷特综合征儿童的多模态正念干预框架
摘要：图雷特综合征影响儿童的日常功能，并需要针对抽动行为、情绪状态和互动情境提供有监督的支持。我们构建了MindTS-MMD，一个涵盖情绪、抽动相关行为、互动情境及效价-唤醒度评分的中文多模态数据集，并开发了MindTS-Net，一种将多模态情绪感知、正念策略规划、适合儿童的引导生成和对话状态追踪相连接的监督式数字辅助工具。评估包括数据集基准测试、一项纳入60名儿童的14天主要临床研究，以及来自第二临床中心的57名儿童的独立外部验证队列。与基线方法相比，MindTS-Net在情绪感知、策略选择和引导质量方面均有提升。在主要研究中，接受MindTS-Net干预的儿童表现出有利的效价-唤醒度变化及抽动负担减轻。外部验证在感知、策略、引导和干预结果方面显示出一致的方向。这些发现表明，监督式多模态数字支持可补充儿童抽动管理，并为未来多中心研究奠定基础。
关键词：图雷特综合征；多模态情绪感知；正念干预；人工智能；效价-唤醒度

title: The naive brain detects face-to-face biological motion.
summary: Detecting agents and their interactions is a cornerstone of social cognition. Vertebrates are known to possess innate sensitivity to animacy cues, such as self-propelled or biological motion, supported by subpallial circuits within the social behavior network (SBN). However, the neural mechanisms distinguishing the detection of animate motion from the recognition of socially meaningful relations remain unclear. Using visually naive female domestic chicks, we investigated the brain regions activated when observing point-light displays of hens moving face-to-face or back-to-back, a behavioral paradigm previously shown to reveal spontaneous sensitivity to social interaction. We found selective immediate early-gene expression in the nidopallium caudolaterale, homologous to the mammalian prefrontal cortex, but not in the nucleus taeniae of the amygdala and septum, subpallial areas in the SBN. This pattern suggests that while basic sensitivity to animate motion may rely on evolutionarily ancient subpallial circuits, the detection of socially relevant relations engages higher order pallial processing.

标题：天真的大脑检测面对面的生物运动
摘要：检测主体及其互动是社会认知的基石。已知脊椎动物对生命性线索（如自发运动或生物运动）具有先天敏感性，这一能力由社会行为网络（SBN）中的皮层下回路支持。然而，区分动物运动检测与社会意义关系识别的神经机制仍不清楚。利用视觉天真的雌性雏鸡，我们研究了其在观察母鸡面对面或背对背移动的点光源显示时所激活的脑区，这一行为范式此前已被证明能揭示对社会互动的自发敏感性。我们发现，在尾外侧新纹状体（与哺乳动物前额叶皮层同源）中存在选择性的即刻早期基因表达，而在杏仁核的纹状体核团和隔区（SBN中的皮层下区域）中则未观察到。这一模式表明，尽管对动物运动的基本敏感性可能依赖于进化上古老的皮层下回路，但对社会相关关系的检测则涉及更高等级的皮层处理。
关键词：社会认知；生物运动；面部互动；前额叶同源区；即刻早期基因
